lines.en: scene furlough22
: Heh?
: The...science fair!
lines.zh: : 那个……科学展览！

lines.en: : This...never would have happened if...you just...didn’t beat me!
lines.zh: : 如果……你当初没有赢我……这一切……根本不会发生！

lines.en: : You ruined...everything! I finally...could have...made my parents...proud of me!
lines.zh: : 你毁了……一切！我本来终于可以……让我的父母……为我骄傲的！

lines.en: scene furlough23
: If that never happened...I never would have wanted revenge...I never would have started watching you...being jealous of you...
lines.zh: : 如果那件事没发生……我就不会想报复……我就不会开始盯着你……嫉妒你……

lines.en: : It’s all because you ruined the {i}one{/i} thing in my life that I felt like I did well! You ruined it!
lines.zh: : 都是因为你毁了我这辈子唯{i}一{/i}觉得自己做得好的事！你毁了它！

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在跟我开玩笑吧？

lines.en: scene furlough24
: It’s not funny!
lines.zh: : 一点都不好笑！

lines.en: : You...tried to ruin my life...over the fucking {i}science fair?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……为了他妈的一个{i}科学展览{/i}……就想毁了我的人生？

lines.en: : You...You ruined mine first! You-
lines.zh: : 是、是你先毁了我的！你——

lines.en: scene furlough25
: Hah...hahah...hahaha...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈哈……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Hahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Why are you laughing? It’s not-
lines.zh: : 你笑什么？这又不——

lines.en: scene furlough26
: I'm laughing because you’re a fucking joke.
lines.zh: : 我笑是因为你真他妈是个笑话。

lines.en: : I’m not a joke. Just because I’m not as lucky or gifted as you doesn’t mean I-
lines.zh: : 我不是笑话。就算我没有你那么幸运、那么有天赋，也不代表我——

lines.en: : No. You’re seriously a fucking joke.
lines.zh: : 不。你是真的他妈是个笑话。

lines.en: : And if you ever try to come between Sensei and me again, I will snap your trachea like a twig.
lines.zh: : 而且如果你再敢插到 Sensei 和我中间来，我就把你的气管像折断一根树枝一样捏断。

lines.en: scene furlough27
: D...Don’t laugh at me! Ayane!
lines.zh: : 别……别笑我！Ayane！

lines.en: : I wonder if Sensei and the others are back at home yet? I might still be able to catch up if I start running.
lines.zh: : 不知道 Sensei 他们回家了没有？如果我现在开始跑，说不定还追得上。

lines.en: : Pay attention to me! This is serious!
lines.zh: : 看着我！这是认真的！

lines.en: scene furlough28
: What’s so serious about you wanting attention? That’s literally all you ever do. It’s pathetic. {i}You’re{/i} pathetic. Trash. Worthless. Scum. Go fuck yourself.
lines.zh: : 你想要关注这件事，有什么好认真的？你他妈一直就只会干这个。可悲。{i}你{/i}可悲。垃圾。一文不值。人渣。去你妈的。

lines.en: : I just...I just wanted to feel like I-
lines.zh: : 我只是……我只是想让自己觉得我——

lines.en: : I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。

lines.en: : In fact, I kind of wish you were dead.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我有点希望你死了算了。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I am going to go hang out with a group of people who enjoy my presence. Which is, coincidentally and quite hilariously, something you will never be able to do.
lines.zh: : 那么，恕我失陪，我要去和一群喜欢和我在一起的人待着了。顺带一提，也很滑稽——这恰恰是你永远做不到的事。

lines.en: : There are...people who-
lines.zh: : 可是……也有人——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : There really aren’t, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 真的没有，Kirin。

lines.en: scene black
{i}I heard from someone else that things went better than I thought they would.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我从别人那里听说，事情比我预想的顺利。{/i}

lines.en: {i}How ironic.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}真讽刺。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ve grown so used to the slow burn of divine comedy that any punchline dissimilar to the feeling brought on by fiery coals beneath my feet is like an ice pack for an aneurysm.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我已经太习惯那种慢火炖煮的神圣喜剧，以至于任何一点点不像「脚底踩着烧红的炭」的笑点，都像是给脑动脉瘤敷上的冰袋。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It helps, but just slightly enough to distract me from the fact that everything is horrible and that it will all be over soon.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有点用，但也只是勉强够让我分神，不至于一直想着一切都很糟、而且很快就要结束了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or at least it would be in most cases.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}至少在大多数情况下会是这样。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The cycle would see otherwise.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可循环不这么看。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But it seems the cycle can’t see at all.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但看来这循环根本什么都看不见。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For if it could, none of this would happen.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为如果它看得见，这一切都不会发生。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For if it could, things would never change.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为如果它看得见，事情就永远不会改变。{/i}

lines.en: {i}It’s so interesting that they finally are.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有意思的是，它们终于开始变了。{/i}
